interface.signature: def search_substr(fullText: str, searchText: str, allowOverlap: bool) -> int:

preconditions.expression: isinstance(fullText, str) and isinstance(searchText, str) and isinstance(allowOverlap, bool)
preconditions.description: fullText and searchText must be strings, and allowOverlap must be a boolean.

postconditions.description: If searchText is empty, return_value must be 0; otherwise, return_value must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(fullText) - len(searchText) + 1) if fullText[i:i+len(searchText)] == searchText and (allowOverlap or i == 0)) if searchText != '' else True)
postconditions.description: For non-empty searchText, return_value must equal the count of non-overlapping (if allowOverlap is False) or overlapping (if allowOverlap is True) occurrences of searchText in fullText.
